Hello maintainers,

We are reviewing the unmodified eastasianwidth 0.2.0 npm package, gitHead b89f04d44dc786885615e94cd6e2ba1ef7866fa4, for development within a single organization. We are following this existing issue rather than opening a duplicate.

We found the authentic MIT-LICENSE.txt added by commit 1d41951a59d63fb2d77cda021050fc070cae424a on 2024-06-05, beginning "Copyright komagata". At that commit package.json is version 0.3.0, and eastasianwidth.js differs from the 0.2.0 source. We therefore have not assumed that this later notice settles the older version's exact notice obligations.

Could a maintainer confirm whether that complete notice also applies to the unmodified 0.2.0 release? If a different notice is required, please provide the original wording or an authoritative fixed reference. The 0.2.0 README credits takenspc's East Asian Width article; please also clarify whether incorporated code/data is covered by the stated MIT grant or needs additional attribution or terms.

This is an information request only. It does not request paid work, a purchase, relicensing, or a new contract. No project files or internal deployment information are attached. Thank you.

Hello maintainers,

We are reviewing @npmcli/agent 3.0.0, gitHead 94f346d882458ac9481d015c55057d15f5899bf1, as an unchanged dependency of an internally used development toolchain within a single organization.

The exact published archive and source revision declare ISC but we did not find the complete copyright and permission notice. This issue's subject is version 4.0.0; an existing participant also asks about 3.0.0. We are following that request and have not treated another participant's question or package author metadata as a publisher grant.

Could an authorized maintainer identify the complete original notice applicable to 3.0.0, including the precise holder/year wording if any? If an organization-wide, npm aggregate or other notice applies, please identify its authoritative location and explicitly confirm its package/version scope. We will preserve that wording rather than infer it from another release or an ISC template.

This is an information request only, not paid work, relicensing, a purchase or a new contract. No project files or internal deployment information are attached. Thank you.
